mapper.select: /* 공동양육 초대 단건 조회 */ SELECT JNT_BRUP_INVTN_SN , SNDR_MBR_SN , RCVR_MBR_SN , INVTN_STTS_CD , INVTN_TRGT_EML_ENC , INVTN_TRGT_EML_HMAC , INVTN_EXPRY_DT , ACPT_RFSL_RSPNS_DT , INVTN_TKN_HASH , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , MDFR_ID FROM JNT_BRUP_INVTN WHERE JNT_BRUP_INVTN_SN = #{jntBrupInvtnSn}

/* 내가 보낸 공동양육 초대 목록 조회 (최신순, 반려동물별 상태) */ SELECT I.JNT_BRUP_INVTN_SN , I.INVTN_TRGT_EML_ENC , CASE WHEN M.REG_DT IS NOT NULL AND M.REG_DT <= I.REG_DT THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS RCVR_JOINED , I.REG_DT , AS INVTN_STTS_CD , I.INVTN_EXPRY_DT , P.PET_SN , P.PET_NM , P.PET_SE_CD , AS PET_INVTN_STTS_CD FROM JNT_BRUP_INVTN I JOIN INVTN_TRGT_PET T ON T.JNT_BRUP_INVTN_SN = I.JNT_BRUP_INVTN_SN JOIN PET P ON P.PET_SN = T.PET_SN AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN MBR M ON M.MBR_SN = I.RCVR_MBR_SN WHERE I.SNDR_MBR_SN = #{sndrMbrSn} ORDER BY I.REG_DT DESC , I.JNT_BRUP_INVTN_SN DESC , T.INVTN_TRGT_PET_SN

/* 초대 대상 반려동물 조회 (삭제된 반려동물 제외) */ SELECT P.PET_SN , P.PET_NM , P.PET_SE_CD , AS PET_INVTN_STTS_CD FROM INVTN_TRGT_PET T JOIN JNT_BRUP_INVTN I ON I.JNT_BRUP_INVTN_SN = T.JNT_BRUP_INVTN_SN JOIN PET P ON P.PET_SN = T.PET_SN AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE T.JNT_BRUP_INVTN_SN = #{jntBrupInvtnSn} ORDER BY T.INVTN_TRGT_PET_SN
